notes.title: Release 0.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello, exorcists!

You've waited a long time.
Finally added a multiplayer alpha play test.

Let's take a look!



[h1]1. New Mode: Multi-Play[/h1]


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ZD6FiUFNHg2RpAs4Vy/giphy.gif[/img]

Inside the court, there is a space where exorcists stay together.
Go and kill the zombies with your colleagues here.




[h1]2. Best exorcist: Ranking system[/h1]


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/qIIK8z4ReGvcDqhRx7/giphy.gif[/img]

Compete how many zombies you caught. In the center of the lobby,
you can see the rankings of exorcists.




[h1]3. Weapon Upgrade: Empty Room(?)[/h1]


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYmFmNzYwZTM3YWVmNjExN2Y5MDdkODFjOTY3MWNkZGJiMTg2ODExOSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZzX2dpZklkJmN0PWc/mjGXY8NmxSBZjOYkuO/giphy.gif[/img]

Although these rooms are still empty, we will gradually fill them with space to upgrade weapons with gold bars that you acquired while clearing the stage.




[h1]4. Multi-stage: Beach Village[/h1]


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/aNDxDhtubOyOdD106L/giphy.gif[/img]

If you've greeted and chatted with your colleagues, let's make a room and enter the stage.




[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZDY3MDU5YTBkZTk2MWRmNTA4ZWNiZTViYTgwOTg4NzBjNmE0ZGFlYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZzX2dpZklkJmN0PWc/TrPjQxmYNkN3Xcg3Px/giphy.gif[/img]

Kill the zombies that are pouring out with your colleagues.




[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZGVhODYxMzQzNmE3NGVlMmU0ODg0YWEzOWRiMDNlM2FlZTUzOTFjNiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZzX2dpZklkJmN0PWc/uYiWWblF1nbhQ4rAaw/giphy.gif[/img]


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYTcxMDMyOWZiNWM0Y2VhZWM2NTQyOGE0ZDY2OTY0MWNhYmE0MzUyMCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZzX2dpZklkJmN0PWc/iAej3EAGK7XAPOZsqC/giphy.gif[/img]






[h1]5. Stove Indie Store[/h1]

A game will be added to the stove indie.




[h1]CHANGELOG :[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add Multi-Play Mode
[*] Create Player Avatar
[*] Add options and exit buttons to the exorcism book
[*] Stove Indie Store
[/list]

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Tutorial VIVE Weapon Switch Button Modified
[*] Activate the Boss Zombie Weapon Trail
[*] Disabling the display of projectiles and particles of weapons when hiding a shaman boss
[*] Fix the phenomenon of stopping projectiles in zombie skills with weapons
[/list]

It's been two months. I tried to put multi in the existing single game, but it was a little late due to trial and error. I hope you enjoy the 0.5.0 version as well, and I'm always waiting for your valuable feedback!

Thanks.

If you have any questions or suggestions, please participate in our discord! 🙌

📍Discord : [https://discord.gg/K3YTnMkr6h]

notes.title: Release 0.4.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello, exorcists!

In the Release 0.4.0 version update, a new stage "Shaman's house" was added. Play the next stage to see new maps and zombies.

New platforms have also been added. Let's take a look!




[h1]1. New Stage : shaman's house[/h1]


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jn9N0GPvUq0kQVXeOg/giphy.gif[/img]

The exorcist, who came down from the top of Halla Mountain and arrived at the shaman's house, tried to question the shamans about all this. But only silence flows inside the shaman's house.

What's going on here?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43509536/b78984521227387eae3d4eaf363001605436bbbc.gif[/img]

Inside the maze-like shaman's house, the exorcist must find clues about evil spirits.



[h1]2. Shaman zombie <Elite>[/h1]

[h3]Fire talismans[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1joFwcO1puqKp0WeDi/giphy.gif[/img]

Unlike previous zombies who rushed recklessly, they made a fire talisman and threw it to the player. If you get hit by a flying talisman, you will receive dot damage for a certain period of time.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/uUl9C4kaHhMkw4OhiY/giphy.gif[/img]

It's better to get rid of it first if possible.





[h1]3. Shaman Zombie <Boss>[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1loNFQJQoQqsDl1xJ2/giphy.gif[/img]

She seems like a gray-haired old woman with a burnt-out back, but she is not really. Her ability is beyond imagination as she is the head of the shamans.

[h3]Throwing fan[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/2sRJtUYdtKvnFi6NDx/giphy.gif[/img]

The players are relentlessly sprinkled with fans that are full of energy. Starting with Phase 2, you should not relax as you throw fans in a row.



[h3]Hiding[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/lXn2sFD8MM7UEw265R/giphy.gif[/img]

Their bodies can move freely anywhere as much as they handle the soul. Watch your back if she disappears from the front.


[h3]the bondage of evil spirits[/h3]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/fqovfqxiKzdJoYwRUn/giphy.gif[/img]

Throw a string tied with a five-coloured cloth to the player. If you hit the mark, it's dragged toward the shaman zombie. Even if you are dragged, you can escape if you catch the line on the way.




[h1]4. Steam Store[/h1]

The release of the PC version is imminent. The Steam page has been opened, so please add it to the wish list.




[h1]5. Response by device[/h1]

Now you can play games even if you're not an Oculus device. Vive, WMR, and Valve Index are compatible, so please enjoy them on your PC. The control method for each controller will be updated soon.






[h1]CHANGELOG :[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add a shaman's house map
[*] Release PC version
[*] OpenXR device specific response (Vive, WMR, Vavle Index)
[/list]

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an intermittent, non-dead issue when the player was damaged by fire & stone harubang.
[*] Improvement of Zombie Movement Path for Tiled House and Shaman House Stage
[/list]




This time, it's been three months. Due to the PC version and the response by device, the period has been extended a little. I hope you enjoy the 0.4.0 version, and I'm always waiting for your valuable feedback!

Happy New Year, and please keep your eyes on us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43509536/8ce8eb60bb96d3d1ec34d1a373eb6347706d640d.png[/img]

Next time, we will come back with an update on the last stage Dock in Jeju Island.Oh, by the way! We're also preparing for a multi-play test, so please wait a little bit!

Thanks.



If you have any questions or suggestions, please participate in our discord! 🙌
